items.title: [CISA KEV] OSGeo GeoServer - OSGeo GeoServer XML Injection Vulnerability
items.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-120705
廠商: OSGeo
產品: GeoServer
漏洞名稱: OSGeo GeoServer XML Injection Vulnerability
說明: OsGeo GeoServer contains an XML injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to cause the server to read local text files accessible to the GeoServer process or fetch attacker-specified HTTP or HTTPS URLs via a crafted ID parameter in the WFS 2.0 GetFeatureById stored query. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-129244, CVE-2026-129243, CVE-2026-129245, and CVE-2026-129242 to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution on an affected GeoServer instance.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-11-30
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

items.title: [CISA KEV] OSGeo GeoServer - OSGeo GeoServer Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
items.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-129243
廠商: OSGeo
產品: GeoServer
漏洞名稱: OSGeo GeoServer Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
說明: GeoServer contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to bypass service-level role checks and invoke operations protected solely by those checks via a request with a prefixed service parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-129244, CVE-2026-120705, CVE-2026-129245, and CVE-2026-129242 to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution on an affected GeoServer instance.

items.title: [CISA KEV] Drupal Core - Drupal Core Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions Vulnerability
items.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-136716
廠商: Drupal
產品: Core
漏洞名稱: Drupal Core Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions Vulnerability
說明: Drupal Core contains an improper check for unusual or exceptional conditions vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to take over a site via the exposed Drupal installer when the site is in one of the affected unusual or incomplete installation states.
